expect_red: sweep: every verb argument is parsed here, and a bad one answers with the set it had to be in

mutations.contract: A verb's argument grammar is pure and lives in sweep.js, and the message a bad argument gets is the only documentation a reader of the command box has -- so it names the set the argument had to come from.
mutations.note: The mutation accepts any number as a speed. `speed 100` then runs the whole sweep in a frame and `speed 0` freezes playback with the play button still lit, both silently -- and the error that would have said what the four speeds are never happens.
